sanskrit_verse:
पौत्रदौहित्रयोर् लोके विशेषो नास्ति धर्मतः ।
अनेनैव विधानेन सुतं चक्रे�थ पुत्रिकाम् ॥
transliteration: pautradauhitrayor loke viśeṣo nāsti dharmataḥ / anenaiva vidhānena sutaṃ cakre 'tha putrikām //
sph_interpretive_translation: In the eyes of Dharma, no distinction exists between grandson and granddaughter; by this same ordinance was the daughter's son created, as well as the son's daughter.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from consciousness, not gender or lineage position
Causation aligns with dharma-siddha intentionality, not biological determinism
Capacity-based responsibility flows from svadharma realization, not birth order
Restoration logic operates through recognition of equal ontological status
Consciousness alignment requires dissolution of hierarchical perceptual bias
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity A and entity B share samāna-dharmic-liability THEN assign parity in inheritance rights
IF generational role is determined by karmic alignment THEN gender shall not arbitrate entitlement
IF consciousness-capacity is unobstructed THEN lineage-position must not condition legal standing
IF dharma-vyavastha recognizes ontological equivalence THEN socio-legal discrimination is nullified
supreme_court_application: The Supreme Court must recognize that dharmically-derived equality supersedes statutory distinctions based on generational or gender positioning within familial structures. Legal precedence upholding unequal treatment due to birth order or sex contradicts the foundational principle of consciousness-authorized equity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that differentiation without causal basis constitutes adharmic perception. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals equality as inherent when viewed through the lens of svadharma rather than social construct. Responsibility lies in aligning cognition with satya-dharma, not enforcing punitive correction upon those acting under mithyā-jñāna.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pramāṇa-realignment process for judicial actors misapplying discriminatory frameworks
Undertake śuddhi-vyavasthāpana for institutions perpetuating unequal intergenerational transmission
Establish svatantrya-pratipatti-krama for all heirs irrespective of positional conditioning
Implement daivī-prakṛti-sthiti-upadeśa to dissolve perceptual distortions causing inequitable distribution
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Dharma stands restored where consciousness prevails over convention, inheritance transcends gender-positioning, and reality reflects non-punitivity through the supremacy of self-realized equity.
